meta.title: Forcelis Group — Financial intelligence from your CFDI
meta.description: Forcelis turns the CFDI your company already issues and receives into management reports, dashboards and findings. For businesses and their advisors.

hero.titleLead: Your CFDI already say how the business is doing.
hero.subtitle: A platform for the people who advise businesses — accountants, practices and consultants — and for businesses that want to understand their own numbers.
priorities: Input costs rising faster than your prices
Margin compression in a key category

audience.label: Who it is for
audience.body: Accountants, practices and consultants who advise companies — and companies with real operating complexity: inventory, suppliers, credit terms.

how.title: From information to action.
how.intro: Every company already issues and receives CFDI. That record says what was sold, to whom, at what price, what it cost and when it was actually collected. What is missing is one place where it is brought together and read by someone who knows what to look for.

flow.label: Action
flow.sub: Decisions with an owner and a measure

how.flowAlt: The CFDI you already have become intelligence, and intelligence becomes action.

steps.name: See
steps.body: Import the information your business already produces.

steps.name: Understand
steps.body: Identify the risks, inefficiencies and drivers that matter.

steps.name: Act
steps.body: Turn findings into decisions, improvements and measurable results.

how.platformNote: The Forcelis platform does the importing and the calculating. People do the judgment.

paths.title: Who is this for?

advisors.title: For accountants and consultants

business.title: For businesses
business.body: A monthly plan to see your company through what you already invoice. If you want a professional review, the Diagnostic is contracted separately.
business.price: Individual plan: {price} MXN per month, before VAT

paths.pricingNote: Prices are published. You can compare the plans without talking to anyone.

platform.title: One view of your business.
platform.body: The Forcelis platform brings your CFDI and electronic accounting together into a unified view of business performance. It is not an ERP and it does not replace your accounting system: it is the intelligence layer above them.
points: Every number is computed by a deterministic engine. No figure is generated by a language model.
Each client's information is isolated at four independent layers, the last of them enforced by the database itself.
Tax credentials are never requested. Ingestion is by files the client downloads themselves.

start.title: If you want human judgment, it is separate.
start.body: The platform works on its own. The Diagnostic, consulting sessions, advisory, projects, Monitoring and Managed Services are delivered by the Forcelis team and contracted separately from any plan.

closing.title: Start with the numbers you already have.
closing.body: No new system, no credentials, no implementation project.
